verdict.rationale: Factory documents a public API reference for creating and driving Droid sessions, including their lifecycle, settings and messages. A probe found a live OpenAPI spec at docs.factory.ai/openapi.json. Programmatic control is backed by a TypeScript SDK running the same agent harness, plus the headless `droid exec` with structured input and output. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actually driving the product through the API (endpoint coverage beyond sessions and auth details are not shown in the pack).
